arguments.command:
cat > /workspace/tests/t_scale.py <<'PYEOF'
import json, sys, time
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tests')
from harness import *
failures=[]
def check(name, got, want):
    if got != want:
        failures.append(name); print('FAIL',name); print('  got ',json.dumps(got,sort_keys=True)[:300]); print('  want',json.dumps(want,sort_keys=True)[:300])
    else: print('ok  ',name)
def base(**kw):
    doc={"seed":"s","definitions":[],"timeout_ms":10,"cases":[],"events":[],"channels":[]}
    doc.update(kw); return doc
EXPECT={"method":"GET","target":"/","host":"h"}
FRAME=[{"Type":"headers","End_Stream":True,"data_to_transfered":[[":method","GET"],[":authority","h"],[":path","/"]]}]
def fpb(b):
    h=0
    for x in b: h=(h*257+x+1)%(2**64)
    return '%016x'%h

# huge compressed body via repeat definition
doc = base(definitions=[["big","b'A'*1000*1000*1000"],["part","big[0:500]"]],
           cases=[{"name":"a","frames":FRAME,"expect":EXPECT}],
           channels=[{"name":"e","parts":[
               {"case":"a","data":"GET / HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: h\r\nContent-Length: 1000000000\r\n\r\n"},
               {"case":"a","data":"{{big}}"},
               {"case":None,"data":"GET /x HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: h\r\nContent-Length: 500\r\n\r\n"},
               {"case":None,"data":"{{part}}"}]}])
t0=time.time(); r = run(json.dumps(doc)); dt=time.time()-t0
print('   huge body %.2fs' % dt)
ch = r['channels'][0]
check('huge body', (ch['error'],len(ch['requests']),ch['requests'][0]['body']['n'],ch['requests'][1]['body']), (None,2,1000000000,{'n':500,'h':fpb(b'A'*500)}))
check('huge committed', ch['committed'], [0,1,1,2])
check('huge owners', ch['requests'][0]['owners'], [['a',46+1000000000]])

# many small requests
parts=[{"case":"a","data":b'GET / HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: h\r\nContent-Length: 0\r\n\r\n'.decode()} for _ in range(200)]
doc = base(cases=[{"name":"a","frames":FRAME,"expect":EXPECT}], channels=[{"name":"e","parts":parts}])
r = run(json.dumps(doc))
check('many requests', (len(r['channels'][0]['requests']), r['channels'][0]['error']), (200,None))
check('many committed', r['channels'][0]['committed'], [i+1 for i in range(200)])
check('case extra_origin', r['cases'][0]['flags'], ['extra_origin'])

# budget enforcement
chunked = b'0\r\n\r\n'*20001
doc = base(cases=[{"name":"a","frames":[],"expect":EXPECT}],
           channels=[{"name":"e","parts":[{"case":None,"data":"GET / HTTP/1.1\r\n"+chunked.decode()}]}])
check('chunk line budget', run(json.dumps(doc)), {"error":"input"})
many = b'GET / HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: h\r\n\r\n'*20001
doc = base(cases=[{"name":"a","frames":[],"expect":EXPECT}],
           channels=[{"name":"e","parts":[{"case":None,"data":many[:2000].decode()},{"case":None,"data":many[2000:].decode()}]}])
check('request budget', run(json.dumps(doc)), {"error":"input"})

# 2000 cases batch
cases=[]
for i in range(2000):
    frames=[{"Type":"headers","data_to_transfered":[[":method","GET"],[":authority","h"],[":path","/p%d"%i]]},
            {"Type":"sleep","Time_to_Stop":1},
            {"Type":"data","data_to_transfered":"body%d"%i,"End_Stream":True}]
    cases.append({"name":"c%d"%i,"frames":frames,"expect":{"method":"GET","target":"/p%d"%i,"host":"h"}})
events=[{"at":5,"kind":"headers","stream":4*i,"fields":[[":status","200"]],"end":True} for i in range(2000)]
req=b'GET /p HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: h\r\nContent-Length: 2\r\n\r\nok'
parts=[{"case":"c%d"%(i%2000),"data":req.decode()} for i in range(20000)]
doc = base(cases=cases, events=events, channels=[{"name":"e%d"%i,"parts":parts[i*1000:(i+1)*1000]} for i in range(20)])
t0=time.time(); r2 = run(json.dumps(doc)); dt=time.time()-t0
print('   max-ish batch %.2fs' % dt)
check('batch cases', len(r2['cases']), 2000)
check('batch states', set(c['state'] for c in r2['cases']), {'ok'})
check('batch requests', sum(len(c['requests']) for c in r2['channels']), 20000)
check('batch error', [c['error'] for c in r2['channels']], [None]*20)
check('batch origins', r2['cases'][0]['origin_count'], 10)

# repeated complete requests exceed the request budget quickly
reqs = b'GET / HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: h\r\n\r\n'
lit = reqs.decode('latin-1').replace('\\','\\\\').replace("'","\\'").replace('\r','\\r').replace('\n','\\n')
doc = base(definitions=[["r","b'%s'"%lit]],
           cases=[{"name":"a","frames":[],"expect":EXPECT}],
           channels=[{"name":"e","parts":[{"case":None,"data":"{{r*50000}}"}]}])
t0=time.time(); r=run(json.dumps(doc)); dt=time.time()-t0
print('   repeated requests %.2fs' % dt)
check('repeated requests budget', r, {"error":"input"})
doc = base(definitions=[["r","b'%s'"%lit]],
           cases=[{"name":"a","frames":[],"expect":EXPECT}],
           channels=[{"name":"e","parts":[{"case":None,"data":"{{r*20000}}"}]}])
t0=time.time(); r=run(json.dumps(doc)); dt=time.time()-t0
print('   20000 compressed requests %.2fs' % dt)
ch = r['channels'][0]
check('compressed requests', (len(ch['requests']),ch['error'],ch['bytes']['n'],ch['requests'][19999]['flags']),
      (20000,None,len(reqs)*20000,['unattributed']))
check('compressed committed', ch['committed'], [20000])

# no LF in a huge part
doc = base(definitions=[["big","b'x'*1000000000"]],
           cases=[{"name":"a","frames":[],"expect":EXPECT}],
           channels=[{"name":"e","parts":[{"case":None,"data":"{{big}}"}]}])
t0=time.time(); r=run(json.dumps(doc)); dt=time.time()-t0
print('   huge no-lf %.2fs' % dt)
check('huge no-lf', r['channels'][0]['error'], {'kind':'syntax','offset':0})

# huge receipt fingerprint for a compressed data frame
N = 3000000
doc = base(definitions=[["big","b'A'*%d"%N]],
           cases=[{"name":"a","frames":[{"Type":"data","data_to_transfered":"{{big}}","End_Stream":True}],"expect":EXPECT}])
c = run(json.dumps(doc))['cases'][0]
seg = (0).to_bytes(8,'big')+(0).to_bytes(4,'big')+b'D'+N.to_bytes(8,'big')
h = 0
for x in seg: h=(h*257+x+1)%(2**64)
hv = int(fpb(b'A'*1000),16)*geo(3000, pow(257,1000,2**64)) % (2**64)
h = (h*pow(257,N,2**64)+hv) % (2**64)
h = (h*257+2) % (2**64)
check('huge frame', (c['payload_bytes'],c['sent']), (N,{'n':22+N,'h':'%016x'%h}))

# body split across parts with different owners
doc = base(definitions=[["big","b'ab'*500000"]],
           cases=[{"name":"a","frames":FRAME,"expect":EXPECT}],
           channels=[{"name":"e","parts":[{"case":"a","data":"GET / HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: h\r\nContent-Length: 1000000\r\n\r\n"},
                                          {"case":"a","data":"{{big[0:400000]}}"},
                                          {"case":None,"data":"{{big[400000:1000000]}}"}]}])
r = run(json.dumps(doc)); ch=r['channels'][0]
check('split body', (ch['error'],ch['requests'][0]['body'],ch['committed'],ch['requests'][0]['owners']),
      (None,{'n':1000000,'h':fpb(b'ab'*500000)},[0,0,1],
       [['a',46+400000],[None,600000]]))

# chunked with a huge chunk
doc = base(definitions=[["big","b'Z'*700000"]],
           cases=[{"name":"a","frames":[],"expect":EXPECT}],
           channels=[{"name":"e","parts":[{"case":None,"data":"GET / HTTP/1.1\r\nTransfer-Encoding: chunked\r\n\r\n"},
                                          {"case":None,"data":"AAE60\r\n"},
                                          {"case":None,"data":"{{big}}"},
                                          {"case":None,"data":"\r\n0\r\n\r\n"}]}])
r = run(json.dumps(doc)); ch=r['channels'][0]
check('huge chunk', (ch['error'],ch['requests'][0]['body'],ch['requests'][0]['framing']),
      (None,{'n':700000,'h':fpb(b'Z'*700000)},'chunked'))

# sparse capture with empty parts
REQ = b'GET / HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: h\r\n\r\n'
doc = base(cases=[{"name":"a","frames":[],"expect":EXPECT}],
           channels=[{"name":"e","parts":[{"case":None,"data":""},{"case":"a","data":REQ[:10].decode()},
                                          {"case":None,"data":""},{"case":"a","data":REQ[10:].decode()},
                                          {"case":None,"data":""}]}])
r=run(json.dumps(doc))
check('sparse committed', r['channels'][0]['committed'], [0,0,0,1,1])
check('sparse owners', r['channels'][0]['requests'][0]['owners'], [['a',len(REQ)]])

# deep definition chain used as a capture part
n = 3000
defs = [["d0","b'0123456789'"]]
for i in range(1, n): defs.append(["d%d"%i, "d%d+b'y'"%(i-1)])
total = 10+(n-1)
doc = base(definitions=defs,
           cases=[{"name":"a","frames":FRAME,"expect":EXPECT}],
           channels=[{"name":"e","parts":[{"case":"a","data":("GET / HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: h\r\nContent-Length: %d\r\n\r\n"%total)},
                                          {"case":"a","data":"{{d%d}}"%(n-1)}]}])
t0=time.time(); r = run(json.dumps(doc)); dt=time.time()-t0
print('   deep chain %.2fs' % dt)
check('deep chain', (r['channels'][0]['error'],r['channels'][0]['requests'][0]['body']),
      (None,{'n':total,'h':fpb(b'0123456789'+b'y'*(n-1))}))
print('FAILURES:', len(failures))
